individual_editorial_finding: Verify the original issuer/repository evidence behind every social recommendation and independently assess compensation, identity and timing; a general SEC fraud link does not authenticate any specific tip.
Reconcile the actual filing period, accepted accession and substantive 10-K/10-Q/8-K fields with the scenario; SEC form definitions alone do not validate an invented issuer event.
Preserve separate EDGAR acceptance, public dissemination and learner-observation timestamps; the SEC's typical publication lag is not a guaranteed latency.
Independently recompute price, share-count and value effects of the reverse split and distinguish arithmetic repricing from realized investor return.
Require an unseen issuer or document for the transfer task, and a reviewer proof that primary source publication preceded the fictional decision pause.
Verify ticker-issuer identity, security class, as-of date and explicit watchlist removal/update rules rather than relying on a name-only match.
Separate five-minute ratio calculation from venue/interval compatibility and executable offer depth; no observed last trade guarantees a larger order.
Identify original announcement and conditional-proposal terms; do not classify a proposed order as executed or a reported headline as primary evidence.
Recompute candle body and range using exact OHLC units and retain the limitation that intrabar high-low chronology is unknown.
Recompute midpoint spread as percentage with the midpoint denominator, then verify whether threshold and actual depth support a NO TRADE decision.
Check versioned watchlist ranking, source-update cutoff, ranking weights and reversal evidence so later outcomes cannot rewrite earlier classifications.
The unseen transfer needs two different failures—unverified catalyst and unaffordable spread—and an independently reviewed admissibility/no-trade rubric.
Validate universe, security types and exclusion counts; a scanner's selection criteria must not be interpreted as having examined excluded symbols.
Verify percent change always cites a declared base price and compatible session; dollar-price gain is not equivalent to percentage gain.
Check relative-volume baseline for same interval, session, adjustment and venue; a raw ratio is not evidence of available bid-ask depth.
Separate issuer outstanding share count from vendor-calculated free float and any stale filing; a session's turnover is not unique-owner turnover.
Verify NYSE core versus pre/aftermarket hours against venue/holiday calendar, including broker order eligibility and shortened sessions.
Review both best bid/ask spread arithmetic and visible size at each level; never promise a large market order a one-level fill.
Match catalyst claims to original issuer release, filing accession, public availability and conditional language before scoring a scan.
Validate quote freshness and stale-trade false positives; require real decision-time depth and no hypothetical guaranteed fill.
Require timestamped ranking history and independent future-unseen transfer cases so a former winning symbol cannot predetermine a score.
Audit all scan parameters, data-feed entitlement, query timestamp, excluded universe and reproducible independent re-run.
Confirm T+1 general equity settlement scope and effective 2024-05-28 date; teaching example still needs individual no-trade and question/answer review.
Recompute relative price change against proper start denominator and distinguish a last-sale return from a separately executable quote.
Confirm guided attendance and corrected misconceptions remain practice metrics, not a protected grade or transferable independent mastery.
Check shares outstanding versus estimated float and compare turnover denominators only after validating as-of source and trading session.
Recompute body/range across matched five-minute intervals and avoid inferring within-bar high-before-low order from OHLC.
Check displayed bid-ask depth, cancel risk and realistic partial fills; a visible Level II quote cannot certify execution.
Verify issuer/SEC disclosure accession, publication time and conflicting promotions; require separate source cutoff and execution checks.
Ensure scanner freshness duration is an authored strategy choice, not regulatory requirement; retain reproducible source and sampling limits.
Test support/resistance claims on previously completed bars and a genuinely new case; level identification is not a guaranteed support hold.
Recompute risk per share and whole-share sizing; stop-market orders can slip past stop references and realized loss can exceed plan.
Recompute scaled remainder while keeping planned sales distinct from broker-confirmed fills and stamped execution records.
Separate reported historical tape prints from hypothetical participant fills; prove contemporaneous ask depth or mark as non-executable.
A candle's completed extremes do not disclose within-interval order of moves; require alternate sequences and independent transfer.
Verify provisional intraday versus completed daily green direction with accurate session boundaries and hypothetical cutoff.
A former successful ticker does not forecast a future run; require independently withheld catalyst and spread veto evidence.
Price drops and small bounces alone do not prove panic, recovery or halted-event chronology; require source and liquidity context.
Cross-check current Regulation SHO locate exceptions and broker borrow restrictions, and distinguish short sale price loss from borrowing costs.
Distinguish red intraday open-close from negative versus prior settlement close; first-red-day status requires a closed session.
Independently verify compensated promotional claims and sample denominators; never treat isolated returns as assured or insured.
Reconfirm FINRA daily off-exchange short-sale volume against a venue-compatible denominator; crude fictional 40% ratio is not consolidated short interest or forced-covering proof.
